name: Romano's Hotel
description: A Fitzmaurice Street pub trading since 1857 and run by the Oates family. The site takes in several distinct spaces: the public bar and kitchen, The Hampden cocktail bar, The Barcade with arcade games, and The Laneway outdoor area with a children's play space. Pub-style rooms and The Hampden Suites are available upstairs, and the function spaces seat up to 120 for a sit-down dinner or 200 cocktail style.
highlights: The Laneway outdoor area with children's play area
Pub rooms and Hampden Suites upstairs
Functions for up to 120 seated or 200 cocktail style

name: Victoria Hotel
description: A Baylis Street pub in the Wagga CBD with a bistro serving pub classics and grilled meats for lunch and dinner. The venue shows live sport, runs gaming and TAB facilities, and puts on live music, DJs and karaoke nights. Functions and events can be booked, and the hotel runs the Harvest Gold membership program.
highlights: On Baylis Street in the CBD
Bistro lunch and dinner seven days

name: Union Club Hotel
description: A Baylis Street hotel with four bars built in jarrah wood, 15 tap beers plus bottled beer, wine and spirits, and a wraparound balcony. The bistro seats up to 120 across indoor and alfresco areas and offers gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options. There is a sports bar with TAB terminals and KENO, a Bottlemart bottle shop, live music, trivia nights and themed dinner specials including schnitzel, burger and pizza nights.
highlights: Four bars with jarrah timber counters
Bistro seating up to 120 indoor and alfresco
Sports bar with TAB and KENO

name: William Farrer Hotel
description: A CBD pub and bistro on Peter Street, known locally as The Faz. The bistro serves lunch and dinner using locally sourced produce and grilled dishes, and there is a beer garden plus accommodation upstairs. The hotel shows live sport and hosts functions and regular promotions.
highlights: CBD pub known as The Faz

name: Riverina Hotel
description: A heritage Fitzmaurice Street pub, known as The Riv, that has been trading since 1851. It runs a family friendly bistro with pub classics, chef's specials and a kids menu, plus a drive-thru bottle shop. Live sport plays on big screens, there are TAB facilities, Thursday steak night and Wednesday trivia.
highlights: Family friendly bistro with kids meals
Live sport on big screens and TAB

name: The Astor Hotel & Bar
description: Accommodation, restaurant and bar on Edward Street near the CBD and the railway station. The Mallee Grill restaurant serves steaks and pub classics Monday to Saturday evenings, with pizzas available in the bar and restaurant from 10am daily and lunch on Friday and Saturday. There is a happy hour Thursday to Saturday and function facilities for conferences and private events.
highlights: Boutique rooms near the CBD and railway station

name: Sportsmens Club Hotel
description: A Kincaid Street pub near the Murrumbidgee Turf Club racecourse, known locally as the Sporties. It has a spacious beer garden, a bistro with alfresco seating, weekday lunch specials and nightly dinner specials. Six refurbished pub-style rooms are available upstairs and the venue takes function bookings.
highlights: Weekday lunch and nightly dinner specials

name: Jungle Duke Hotel
description: A family owned hotel on Fitzmaurice Street overlooking the Murrumbidgee River, open seven days for lunch and dinner from 11.30am. The renovated venue serves cocktails including margaritas alongside dishes such as ginger beer battered fish and chips and schnitzel, with lunch specials on the board. There is outdoor seating and the hotel is wheelchair accessible.
highlights: Family owned, overlooking the Murrumbidgee River
Open seven days for lunch and dinner

name: Bar Olivette
description: A basement speakeasy-style bar on Fitzmaurice Street built around a 1920s prohibition theme. It pours prohibition-style cocktails and keeps an extensive whiskey and spirits collection including rare blends sourced from overseas, alongside bar food. Walk-ins are welcome but reservations are preferred, and the bar runs occasional Sunday Smuggler's Compass events.
highlights: Extensive whiskey and rare spirits selection

name: Tilly's Wagga
description: A restaurant and cocktail bar on Baylis Street serving share plates and main meals alongside an extensive cocktail list of seasonal signatures and classics. The venue has a rooftop deck and several function spaces including the Parlour Room, and runs karaoke and DJ nights. A nightclub operates on Saturday nights from 10pm.
highlights: Restaurant and cocktail bar on Baylis Street
Function spaces including the Parlour Room

name: Thirsty Crow Brewing Co
description: A family owned, independent brewpub on Fitzmaurice Street with the working brewery visible from the front bar. It pours its own beers including stouts, rice lagers and ales, plus cider and regional wines, and the kitchen sends out tacos, nachos, salads, pizzas and burgers. There is outdoor seating, function space and live music on weekends.
highlights: Working microbrewery visible from the front bar
House-brewed stouts, rice lagers and ales
Kitchen serving tacos, nachos, pizzas and burgers

name: Wagga RSL Club
addressLine: Corner of Kincaid Street and Dobbs Street
description: A licensed RSL club on the corner of Kincaid and Dobbs Streets in the Wagga CBD, open from 10am to 3am every day and closed only on Christmas Day. Breakfast is served from 8am daily, and the club runs dining venues, bars, a sports bar, gaming and weekly raffles. It hosts entertainment, kids dining and functions, and members get access to club deals and social events. The club also runs the Wagga RSL Bowling Club, which has two championship greens and offers barefoot bowls bookings.
highlights: Open 10am to 3am every day, closed Christmas Day
Two championship bowling greens and barefoot bowls

name: Farmers Home Hotel
description: A Hammond Avenue pub just over the bridge from the Wagga CBD, with an outdoor beer garden and a bistro serving lunch and dinner seven days. The venue is family friendly, has on-site parking and takes function bookings. Trading runs to 3am Monday to Saturday.
highlights: Bistro lunch and dinner seven days

name: Palm & Pawn Motor Inn & Tavern
description: A tavern and motor inn on Hampden Avenue at North Wagga, established in 1976. It has an extensive beer garden with a children's playground and a bistro serving lunch and dinner daily, with steaks, burgers and weeknight specials. A courtesy bus runs Wednesday to Sunday nights and the venue hosts functions and events.
highlights: Extensive beer garden with kids playground
Courtesy bus Wednesday to Sunday nights

name: Black Swan Hotel
description: A small country pub on Gardiner Street at North Wagga Wagga, listed as trading daily from 10am to midnight. It serves cold beer and spirits along with bar and light meals, and the venue is used for functions and receptions.
highlights: Country pub at North Wagga Wagga

name: Tolland Hotel
description: A family friendly local hotel at Tolland, about 4km from the Wagga CBD. It runs a family bistro with a kids menu and indoor play area, a TAB and sports bar with large projector screens, and an outside deck. There is live music on Friday nights, plus function facilities with a courtesy bus and food and beverage packages.
highlights: Family bistro with kids menu and indoor play area
TAB and sports bar with projector screens

name: Kooringal Hotel
description: A suburban hotel on Fay Avenue that has been trading since 1967 under the line "your local since 1967". Facilities include a bar, bistro open daily for lunch and dinner, TAB, a VIP lounge, multiple beer gardens and a children's playground. The venue caters for functions from casual gatherings to formal events and runs a loyalty membership program.
highlights: Bistro open daily for lunch and dinner

name: Turvey Park Hotel
description: A renovated local pub on Bolger Avenue with a courtyard, dining room and betting lounge. The bistro serves lunch and dinner daily with weekday lunch specials and nightly dinner deals, and there is a drive-through bottle shop. Live music plays on weekends and the venue takes function bookings.
highlights: Courtyard, dining room and betting lounge
Weekday lunch specials and nightly dinner deals

name: Ashmont Inn Hotel
description: A recently renovated, family friendly hotel on Tobruk Street in Ashmont, close to the Pomingalarna bicycle park. It serves food and drinks and has an attached bottle shop. Trading is 10am to midnight Monday to Saturday and 10am to 10pm Sunday.

name: Rules Club Wagga
description: A large licensed club on Fernleigh Road with a bistro serving wood-fired pizzas, a cafe, a sports bar, a gaming room and multiple function rooms including a boardroom and bridal room. Outside there are bowling greens with barefoot bowls, a sports oval, netball courts and tennis courts. A courtesy bus runs, the club holds bingo and raffles, and the adjoining 79-room Quality Hotel provides accommodation with secure parking.
highlights: Bistro with wood-fired pizzas and a cafe
Sports oval, netball and tennis courts

name: The Blamey Hotel
description: A family friendly pub and bistro on Main Street at Lake Albert with a free courtesy bus. The bistro serves lunch and dinner daily, sport plays on large screens, and there is a bottle shop with a delivery service. Live entertainment runs Friday and Saturday evenings, and the venue has gaming and TAB plus function space.

name: Wagga Wagga Country Club
description: A golf club on Plumpton Road set along the banks of Lake Albert, with an 18-hole championship course of 6,054 metres off the back markers, bent greens and all-weather fairways. The clubhouse holds the Lakeview Eatery, open for lunch and dinner, and a pro shop offering equipment and coaching. Function facilities cater for up to 200 people and the club offers golf memberships and reciprocal club access.
highlights: Lakeview Eatery for lunch and dinner

name: Uranquinty Hotel
description: A village pub on Morgan Street at Uranquinty, open Monday to Sunday from midday. It has a public bar with TAB and gaming machines, a bottle shop with takeaway, and bistro meals for dine-in or takeaway Wednesday to Sunday. The pub runs a courtesy bus, offers free camping and a children's play area, and displays historical memorabilia, with regular raffles and pub draws through the week.
highlights: Public bar with TAB and gaming machines
Bistro meals Wednesday to Sunday, dine-in or takeaway

name: Junee Hotel
description: A heritage country hotel on Seignior Street, trading since 1878 when it opened as the Railway Hotel, with Federation Filigree and Art Nouveau detailing. The kitchen serves lunch from midday and dinner from 6pm using Riverina produce, and there is a bar, beer garden and bottle shop. Heritage guest rooms are available upstairs, dogs are welcome in the outdoor areas, and the hotel takes function bookings.
highlights: Operating since 1878, originally the Railway Hotel
Federation Filigree and Art Nouveau building
Lunch and dinner using Riverina produce

name: Criterion Hotel Gundagai
description: A Sheridan Street pub in Gundagai whose bar carries original oil-painted murals depicting bushrangers and the 1852 flood. Meals and pizzas are served seven nights a week in a family friendly setting. The hotel has King Single, Queen and Family accommodation rooms, and runs live music, happy hour, pool competitions and sport on screen.
highlights: Bar with original oil-painted historical murals
King Single, Queen and Family rooms

name: Temora Ex-Services Memorial Club
description: A licensed memorial club on Baker Street in Temora with three bars, the Main Bar, the Cec Macauley Bar and the Frank Matthews Lounge. Dining is at the Gallery Bistro featuring Vinnie's Cuisines, and there are five function rooms for events and meetings plus a bowling green. The club runs raffles, footy tipping, a poker league and entertainment, and a courtesy bus operates Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 5pm. Two associated motor inns, the Goldtera and Koreela Park, provide accommodation.
highlights: Three bars including the Frank Matthews Lounge
Courtesy bus Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 5pm
Associated Goldtera and Koreela Park motor inns

name: Narrandera Ex-Servicemen's Club
description: A licensed club on Bolton Street in Narrandera describing itself as a venue for dining, entertainment and community. The Riverina Wok N Grill restaurant operates on site alongside the bar. The club runs weekly raffles, member badge draws, live entertainment, social dancing classes, trivia, bingo and poker, and takes function bookings.
highlights: Riverina Wok N Grill restaurant on site
Weekly raffles and member badge draws

name: Coolamon Hotel
description: A historic pub on Cowabbie Street in Coolamon, established in 1880, split into several distinct spaces: The Garden outdoor bar, The Dining Room, The Front Bar for cocktails and casual drinks, The Glasshouse covered dining area, The Lounge and The Long Room for functions. The pub is open daily from 11.30am with the kitchen running 11.30am to 2.30pm and 5.30pm to 8.30pm, and pizza available seven days. Accommodation, weddings, functions and online ordering are all offered.
highlights: The Long Room for functions and weddings

name: Lockhart Ex-Servicemen's Club
description: A community club on Green Street in Lockhart, open seven days from 10.30am until late. Food and beverage service runs from published menus, and the club holds weekly trivia nights. Thursday raffles sell from 6pm and are drawn at 7.30pm with a members draw between 6pm and 8pm, and Sunday raffles sell from 11am and are drawn at 1pm.
highlights: Thursday raffles and members cash draw

name: The Rock Memorial Bowling Club
description: A lawn bowls club on Urana Street at The Rock that has been operating since 1939. Dining is at Crystal's Restaurant with an Australian menu, and there is a bar alongside the greens. The club programs live music, bingo and trivia nights, and offers membership with discounts and access to club events.

name: Culcairn Hotel
description: A country hotel on Railway Parade in Culcairn offering budget accommodation in Queen, Single, Twin Share and Family rooms, all with shared bathrooms upstairs and flat-screen smart TVs. The venue also runs a bistro, a beer garden and a playground. Extended stay discounts are available and accommodation reception is closed on Christmas Day.
highlights: Budget pub accommodation with shared bathrooms
Queen, Single, Twin Share and Family rooms

name: Holbrook Returned Servicemen's Club
description: A returned servicemen's club on Swift Street in Holbrook with a restaurant, bar, and Keno and TAB betting. The club takes in a golf club and a bowls club, along with boating and angling sections. It offers memberships and hosts functions, trading 10am to 9pm Saturday to Thursday and until 10.30pm on Friday.
